collections_none: You have no Wallhaven collections yet.
dups_hint: Exact copies and the same picture at another size. The copy to keep is picked already (the largest); click another to keep it instead. The others go to the trash; their favorite and tags move to the kept one.
f_exact: Exact resolutions (any number; none means any)
f_konachan_net: konachan.net only has safe images. For the other ratings, pick konachan.com in Settings.
f_min_unused: The minimum isn't used while exact resolutions are picked (Wallhaven takes one or the other).
f_nsfw_needs_key: NSFW needs a Wallhaven API key; without one it's left out. Set it in the app (Settings → Wallhaven).
f_ratios: Aspect ratios (any number; none means any)
f_sort_hint: Sort is next to the search box. Changes are saved as you make them and shared with the app; Done searches again.
fit_hint: On every monitor. Automatic uses the monitor's fit (Settings). hyprpaper only.
layout_tooltip: Show everything at once, or browse folder by folder
list_failed: Could not read the wallpicker library
missing_command: The wallpicker command wasn't found on Noctalia's PATH, in ~/.local/bin or in ~/.cargo/bin. Install it there, or set its full path in this plugin's settings.
now_hide: Hide what each monitor is showing
now_show: Show what each monitor is showing
random_tooltip: Apply a random one of those shown (Ctrl+R)
s_fit_hint: Fit mode is for every monitor, unless it has its own just above; a wallpaper's own fit (its view, or right-click → Fit…) wins over both. Needs a newer hyprpaper: leave it on default if applying fails.
s_key_hint: Needed for NSFW results. Set or change it in the app, so the key never passes through a command line.
s_noctalia_hint: Noctalia draws the wallpaper and keeps it across restarts. Its fill mode and transitions are in Noctalia's settings (Wallpaper).
s_noctalia_off: Noctalia's wallpaper is turned off, so applying will fail. Turn it on in Noctalia's settings (Wallpaper), or pick hyprpaper.
s_show_any: Any of the tags (off: all of them)
s_show_each: A different wallpaper on each monitor
s_show_off_hint: Off. This plugin keeps time for it while Noctalia runs.
search_placeholder: Search. Konachan/yande.re: tags, comma-separated (long hair, night) or long_hair night

command.description: The wallpicker command (on your PATH, or an absolute path)
command.label: wallpicker command

showing_first: Showing the first {shown} of {total}. Filter to find the rest.
tags_mode_tooltip: With several tags on: wallpapers with all of them, or any of them
tags_search_hint: Tags (click one to search for it)
title: wallpicker
trash_confirm: Move this wallpaper to the trash? Its favorite and tags go with it.
trash_failed: Could not move it to the trash
trash_hint: Goes to your desktop trash; restore it from your file manager.
